name: Peri-Peri Chicken Livers
description: Pan-fried livers in a creamy peri-peri sauce, served with toasted ciabatta for mopping up.

name: Roasted Butternut Soup
description: Butternut roasted with nutmeg and a little chilli, finished with cream and pumpkin seeds.

name: Calamari Strips
description: Lightly dusted and flash-fried. Comes with lemon and a garlic aioli.

name: Halloumi & Fig Salad
description: Grilled halloumi, fresh figs, rocket and a balsamic reduction.

name: Bobotie
description: Spiced mince baked under a savoury egg custard. Served with yellow rice and chutney.

name: 300g Sirloin
description: Basted and grilled to your liking, with hand-cut chips and a pepper or mushroom sauce.

name: Cape Malay Vegetable Curry
description: Sweet potato, chickpeas and spinach in a fragrant curry. Basmati rice and sambals on the side.

name: Line Fish of the Day
description: Ask your waiter what came in this morning. Grilled with lemon butter, served with seasonal veg.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Arborio rice with porcini and button mushrooms, parmesan and a drizzle of truffle oil.

name: Malva Pudding
description: Warm, sticky and spongy, with custard or vanilla ice cream. A proper South African classic.

name: Milk Tart
description: Thin buttery crust, smooth milky filling and a generous dusting of cinnamon.

name: Chocolate Fondant
description: Gooey centre, baked to order. Please allow 15 minutes.

name: Rooibos Iced Tea
description: House-brewed rooibos with honey, lemon and fresh mint.

name: Craft Lager
description: A crisp local lager on tap. 440ml.

name: Granadilla Soda
description: Fresh granadilla pulp topped up with soda water. Not too sweet.

name: Flat White
description: Double shot with velvety steamed milk.
